difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the projective space bundle formula: the sum of the Chern class correspondences from the direct sum of twisted motives of the base to the motive of the projectivization is an isomorphism (statement lines 1390-1398). The proof (proof lines 1399-1416) reduces by Manin's criterion to the classical formula on Chow groups and identifies the maps using the description of pushforwards along graphs. H2: a complete short reduction.
